novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a new mechanistic relationship: the internal belief allegedly “freezes at a locatable point in the trace before textual/logit commitment,” and steering a plasticity direction can selectively restore later updating. Searches for “LLM internal belief dynamics reasoning steps,” “belief freezing late evidence activation steering,” and “LLM confirmation bias internal representations” identify Belief Dynamics Reveal the Dual Nature of In-Context Learning and Activation Steering (2025) and Constrained Belief Updates Explain Geometric Structures in Transformer Representations (2025) as the closest work, but those respectively model belief change under context/steering and characterize constrained updates rather than hypothesize a probe-visible, temporally preceding collapse of plasticity during generated reasoning. Moving from those works to stepwise probing is natural, but the predicted freeze-before-commitment relationship and selective causal unfreezing constitute a new core relationship rather than merely renaming probing or changing the dataset, supporting high novelty within an established framework rather than paradigm-level novelty.
